backendProtocolControl.scope: Independent owned stdio control and public pinned source, not production/native UI evidence

resultContract.fileIndex: Each symbol/child independently indexes Files; omitted file means zero. Never inherit parent file index.
resultContract.version: Result has no document version; valid client snapshots remain necessary.
resultContract.semantics: Syntactic symbols from the narrowest metadata CompiledGoFiles; methods grouped by unpacked receiver base name; server sorts top-level symbols by name.

observed: Both actual v0.21.1 sessions advertised gopls.package_symbols.
Base URI selected methods.go/model.go/private.go; private symbols returned, while internal/external tests were excluded.
Internal test URI selected base files plus model_test.go, including Record.TestOnly and TestSmoke.
External test URI selected sample_test/external_test.go only.
Record type from model.go had Lookup method from methods.go, whose omitted file index zero differed from parent index one.
Generic Box[T] receiver method ValueCopy grouped under Box; symbol name excluded receiver prefix.
A same-line Chinese identifier after emoji returned valid UTF-16 selection (4,19)..(4,21); all recursively returned symbol selections were decoded against their own file.
Dirty didChange of methods.go changed Lookup to DirtyLookup in a subsequent command querying unchanged model.go, while disk stayed initial.
New didOpen overlay unsaved.go appeared as OverlayOnly in the package response without creating a disk file.
Default query excluded active/absent build tags, windows suffix, underscore-prefixed file, and subpackage. A second session with -tags=active added ActiveOnly.
Querying excluded absent.go directly yielded a singleton containing AbsentOnly; this is not evidence it belongs to the normal selected build package.
Missing command arguments returned error code0 with DecodeArgs expected1/got0; notes.txt query returned empty package name, singleton Files and no symbols rather than an error.
knownSourceBounds: NarrowestMetadataForFile picks the fewest-file package; test variants are possible, intermediate test variants are removed.
PackageSymbols falls back to the query URI when metadata lookup fails. No same-directory enumeration fallback is required client-side.
OverlayFS checks open-document overlays before delegate disk reads.
Top-level blank declarations are skipped; grouping is syntax-based and is not proof of alias canonicalization or receiver semantic validity.
integrationPlan: Check the matched initialized server executeCommandProvider command capability; retain document-only behavior when unsupported.
Use actual client URI mapping and normal LSP4IJ initialized/document-connect ordering; issue the command off EDT with cancellation and immutable query/semantic generation ownership.
Treat the package result as the whole selected package symbol dataset, including current file, to avoid NodeProvider duplication.
Map every node through its own file index and validate bounds/URI/range; perform required VFS/PSI/document discovery only in background.
Use current versioned documents for UTF-16 navigation and reject stale completions when relevant package/metadata inputs change; do not treat response arrival as source acknowledgement.
Keep standard native Structure model/tree actions/renderers; show current package symbols with optional filename suffixes, not invented file containers.
Retain public/private filtering and sorting as client presentation state; package_symbols does not enforce export visibility.

additionalPublicSourceFindings.classification: observed pinned public source, not commercial implementation
additionalPublicSourceFindings.finding: PackageSymbols stores receiver methods separately and attaches them only when a matching receiver base-name type symbol exists. A method with an unresolved/missing receiver declaration can therefore be omitted from this helper result. This is syntax grouping, not receiver type validation or alias canonicalization.
additionalPublicSourceFindings.integrationBoundary: The reconstruction detects uncovered lexical receiver-method selections and asks textDocument/documentSymbol only for affected files, merging by file/kind/selection identity. That independently implemented recovery and its tests belong in verification, not proof that the commercial reference or helper has the same behavior.

additionalPublicSourceFindings.finding: The server command handler stably sorts top-level results by name and then start line. The client may restore deterministic file/source order before optional native sorters; the helper itself is not a type-checked schema.
